GameVoteSummary.title: GameVoteSummary
GameVoteSummary.description: Aggregate community FPS compatibility vote counts for a single game.

runsGreatCount.description: Total number of users who voted Runs Great.

lagsCount.description: Total number of users who voted Lags.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest vote update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserGameVote.title: UserGameVote
UserGameVote.description: Individual authenticated user's compatibility vote for a specific game.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the voter.

gameId.description: Game identifier matching the parent document.

verdict.description: User vote verdict: runs_great or lags.

deviceSoc.description: Detected hardware/SoC name of the voter's device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vote was first cast (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vote was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/game_votes/{gameId}.description: Aggregate community verdict counts per game.

/game_votes/{gameId}/votes/{userId}.description: Per-user vote document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
